properties.displayName: FileEvent ASIM filtering parser for Salesforce Real-Time Event Monitoring
properties.query:
// Schema: FileEvent 1.0.0. Missing source filenames remain empty; IDs are not paths.
let parser = (
    starttime: datetime = datetime(null),
    endtime: datetime = datetime(null),
    eventtype_in: dynamic = dynamic([]),
    srcipaddr_has_any_prefix: dynamic = dynamic([]),
    actorusername_has_any: dynamic = dynamic([]),
    targetfilepath_has_any: dynamic = dynamic([]),
    srcfilepath_has_any: dynamic = dynamic([]),
    hashes_has_any: dynamic = dynamic([]),
    dvchostname_has_any: dynamic = dynamic([]),
    disabled: bool = false,
    pack: bool = false
) {
    SalesForceRealTimeEventMonitoring_CL
    | where not(disabled)
    | where isnull(starttime) or TimeGenerated >= starttime
    | where isnull(endtime) or TimeGenerated <= endtime
    | where EventType == "FileEventStore"
    | where FileAction in ("API_DOWNLOAD", "UI_DOWNLOAD", "PREVIEW", "UPLOAD")
    | extend
        _SourceType = EventType,
        _Org = tostring(column_ifexists("SalesforceDomain", ""))
    | extend
        _OrgHost = tostring(parse_url(iff(_Org contains "://", _Org, strcat("https://", _Org))).Host),
        SrcIpAddr = iff(isnotnull(parse_ipv4(SourceIp)) or isnotempty(parse_ipv6(SourceIp)), SourceIp, "")
    | extend
        EventStartTime = coalesce(EventDate, TimeGenerated),
        EventEndTime = coalesce(EventDate, TimeGenerated),
        EventCount = toint(1),
        EventVendor = "Salesforce",
        EventProduct = "Real-Time Event Monitoring",
        EventSchema = "FileEvent",
        EventSchemaVersion = "1.0.0",
        EventOriginalType = _SourceType,
        EventOriginalSubType = FileAction,
        // An upload can create a new file or check in a new version.
        EventType = iff(FileAction == "UPLOAD", "FileCreatedOrModified", "FileAccessed"),
        EventSubType = case(FileAction == "UPLOAD", "Checkin", FileAction == "PREVIEW", "Preview", "Download"),
        EventResult = iff(
            PolicyOutcome in ("Block", "MeteringBlock", "EndSession", "TwoFADenied", "TwoFAReportedDenied")
                or PolicyOutcome startswith "Failed" or PolicyOutcome startswith "TwoFAFailed",
            "Failure", "NA"),
        EventSeverity = "Informational",
        EventUid = coalesce(EventIdentifier, SalesforceObjectId, EventUuid),
        EventOriginalUid = SalesforceObjectId,
        EventOriginalResultDetails = PolicyOutcome,
        EventMessage = FileAction,
        TargetFileName = FileName,
        TargetFilePath = FileName,
        TargetFilePathType = "FileNameOnly",
        TargetFileSize = tolong(ContentSize),
        Dvc = coalesce(_OrgHost, "Salesforce Real-Time Event Monitoring"),
        DvcFQDN = _OrgHost,
        DvcHostname = tostring(split(_OrgHost, ".")[0]),
        DvcDomain = iff(indexof(_OrgHost, ".") >= 0, substring(_OrgHost, indexof(_OrgHost, ".") + 1), ""),
        DvcScope = _OrgHost,
        DvcOriginalAction = PolicyOutcome,
        DvcAction = case(
            PolicyOutcome in ("Block", "MeteringBlock"), "Deny",
            PolicyOutcome == "EndSession", "Terminate",
            PolicyOutcome in ("NoAction", "ExemptNoAction", "MeteringNoAction", "Notified"), "Allow",
            ""),
        ActorUserId = UserId,
        ActorUserIdType = iff(isempty(UserId), "", "SalesforceId"),
        ActorUsername = UserNameDetail,
        ActorUsernameType = iff(isempty(UserNameDetail), "", iff(UserNameDetail contains "@", "UPN", "Simple")),
        ActorScope = _OrgHost,
        ActorSessionId = SessionKey,
        TargetAppName = "Salesforce",
        TargetAppType = "SaaS application",
        RuleName = coalesce(PolicyId, Policy),
        AdditionalFields = iff(pack, bag_pack(
            "DocumentId", DocumentId, "VersionId", VersionId, "VersionNumber", VersionNumber,
            "FileType", FileType, "FileSource", FileSource,
            "FileAction", FileAction, "IsLatestVersion", IsLatestVersion,
            "CanDownloadPdf", CanDownloadPdf, "ProcessDuration", ProcessDuration,
            "LoginKey", LoginKey, "SourceIp", SourceIp,
            "PolicyOutcome", PolicyOutcome, "RelatedEventIdentifier", RelatedEventIdentifier,
            "EvaluationTime", EvaluationTime), dynamic({})),
        DvcEntityKey = "",
        ActorUserEntityKey = "",
        SrcSystemEntityKey = "",
        ActingApplicationEntityKey = "",
        TargetApplicationEntityKey = "",
        ActingProcessEntityKey = "",
        SrcFileEntityKey = "",
        TargetFileEntityKey = "",
        ActorUserAdditionalIds = dynamic([]),
        AdditionalEntities = dynamic([])
    | extend
        DvcDomainType = iff(isempty(DvcDomain), "", "FQDN"),
        FileName = TargetFileName,
        FilePath = TargetFilePath,
        Src = SrcIpAddr,
        IpAddr = SrcIpAddr,
        User = ActorUsername,
        Application = TargetAppName,
        Rule = RuleName
    | where array_length(eventtype_in) == 0 or EventType in (eventtype_in)
    | where array_length(srcipaddr_has_any_prefix) == 0 or SrcIpAddr in (srcipaddr_has_any_prefix) or has_any_ipv4_prefix(SrcIpAddr, srcipaddr_has_any_prefix)
    | where array_length(actorusername_has_any) == 0 or ActorUsername has_any (actorusername_has_any)
    | where array_length(targetfilepath_has_any) == 0 or TargetFilePath has_any (targetfilepath_has_any)
    | where array_length(srcfilepath_has_any) == 0
    | where array_length(hashes_has_any) == 0
    | where array_length(dvchostname_has_any) == 0 or DvcHostname has_any (dvchostname_has_any)
    | project
        TimeGenerated, Type, EventStartTime, EventEndTime, EventCount,
        EventVendor, EventProduct, EventSchema, EventSchemaVersion,
        EventOriginalType, EventOriginalSubType, EventType, EventSubType,
        EventResult, EventSeverity, EventUid, EventOriginalUid,
        EventOriginalResultDetails, EventMessage,
        TargetFileName, TargetFilePath, TargetFilePathType, TargetFileSize, FileName, FilePath,
        Dvc, DvcFQDN, DvcHostname, DvcDomain, DvcDomainType, DvcScope, DvcOriginalAction, DvcAction,
        ActorUserId, ActorUserIdType, ActorUsername, ActorUsernameType,
        ActorScope, ActorSessionId, User, SrcIpAddr, Src, IpAddr,
        TargetAppName, TargetAppType, Application, RuleName, Rule, AdditionalFields,
        DvcEntityKey, ActorUserEntityKey, SrcSystemEntityKey,
        ActingApplicationEntityKey, TargetApplicationEntityKey, ActingProcessEntityKey,
        SrcFileEntityKey, TargetFileEntityKey, ActorUserAdditionalIds, AdditionalEntities
};
parser()
